entities.summary: Lake Liepāja is the fifth-largest lake in Latvia, located near Liepāja in the Liepāja district. The total area of the lake is 37.15 km2, and it has a length of 16.2 km, average depth of 2.0 m, and a shoreline of 44.6 km.
